_readme: DeepGuard audit pipeline LLM configuration — the exact configuration every public audit run uses: the agent-audit workflow copies this file over the cloned core's agent/agents.config.json in every job, so the configuration the community sees here is the configuration that actually runs. All audit roles (sonar / aegis / beacon / harbor / translate) run on the b.ai gateway's glm-5.3-flash (OpenAI-compatible, deepseek-compat behavior kept for thinking params). The API key itself lives in GitHub Secrets (BAI_LLM_KEY) and is never part of this file.

bai.notes: Input limit measured 943K-971K tokens (2026-08-21 probe on deepseek-v4-flash); 900K is the conservative working window. 400 'Input token exceed the limit' is a deterministic pre-dispatch rejection (fail-fast, no retry).
